comment: The sync and soft-sync inputs trigger above 2V by default; a menu switches them to fire on a rising zero crossing instead, so those two jacks have no fixed threshold. Each shape input has its own menu choosing whether 5V or 10V covers the full sweep, and each level input has one choosing 5V or 10V for unity.
